H456.title: the chi2/dof worsening is dominated by ONE region (Israel pronatal well)
H456.metric: Israel share of worsening 166% (>60% bar cleared); recalibrated well 0.015 cuts Israel RMSE 0.367->0.093, pooled in-sample 0.220->0.180; sign misses 0, Korea monotone True
H456.note: single-region confirmed; recalibrating the region-specific Israel scalar closes DEF-8 below baseline while holding sign+Korea, temporally OUT-OF-SAMPLE for the single Israel region (n=1 region, NOT cross-region generalization); core-promotion candidate; OOS Israel test RMSE 0.096

H454.title: per-region depth does NOT generalize out-of-sample [MAKE-OR-BREAK gate]
H454.metric: FAIR (both FIT-only, scored on TEST): per-region 0.229 vs shared pool 0.212; Germany FIT-only g -0.075 wrong-sign; in-sample full de-pool 0.207 > base 0.198
H454.note: Gelman few-groups: no-pooling overfits thin per-group data and loses to complete pooling. Under the fair FIT-only comparison de-pooling does not materially beat the pool out-of-sample, and it also loses on honest in-sample - gate FAILS as predicted -> H451/H452/H461/H462 pre-empted (Occam-pruned as inadmissible).

H455.title: recovery depth is unidentifiable at n~20yr - only the sign is
H455.metric: Germany CI [+0.006,+0.024] excludes Poland [+0.040,+0.050] (mutually exclusive=True); shared g inside all CIs=False; pre-registered CIs, no post-hoc widening
H455.note: per-region depth CIs exclude each other under the pre-registered comparison - depth identifiable

H451.title: hierarchical partial-pooling recovery strength (g_rec_r ~ Normal(mu_g, tau_g))
H451.metric: held-out RMSE 0.2279 > 0.198 bar; lands between static 0.229 and pool 0.208
H451.note: partial pooling shrinks toward the shared pool (small tau=0.112) and does not clear the bar; INADMISSIBLE under H454. Data prefer pooling - regularization was correctly calibrated.

H452.title: per-region data-derived asymptote mu_c_r
H452.metric: freeing mu_c buys +0.0064 in-sample (< 0.010 bar) and full de-pool 0.207 stays +0.0093 above baseline
H452.note: the shared 1.8 ceiling is adequate; a data-fixed mu_c_r buys less than the freely-fit one and cannot pay for itself; INADMISSIBLE under H454.

H453.title: explicit magnitude likelihood selector (chi2/dof, not sign-miss count)
H453.metric: magnitude-honest selector picks 'base (g=0, no well)' (chi2/dof 3.93); no shared g reaches base 3.93
H453.note: the honest full-trajectory likelihood declines the recuperation on magnitude and selects the down-only baseline - the term is a SIGN-only fix. This is the Occam adjudicator for the fanout.

H457.title: the miss is a composition (tempo/cohort) artifact the sign test masks
H457.metric: mean |resid-vs-tempo corr| 0.36; re-timable RMSE ~0.1010 (>= 0.010 bar, but not significant at n~20yr autocorrelated)
H457.note: some gated regions (Italy/Poland) show moderate residual-vs-tempo correlation, but it is not significant given the smooth autocorrelated series, and Germany's recovery is quantum (E46, MAC rose monotonically) so tempo cannot rescue its depth. A tempo carry is NOT adopted - the Occam gate plus E40 Bongaarts-Feeney safety prune it - so composition is a partial, non-shipping story.

H458.title: non-parametric free per-region recovery (and what it costs)
H458.metric: held-out RMSE 0.6588 > pool 0.208; overfits thin data and loses OOS
H458.note: free-form recovery fits in-sample trivially, generalizes worse out-of-sample, and forfeits the mechanism and any forward-prediction claim; the parametric term is preferred even when it fits worse.

H459.title: endogenous N-coupled asymptote mu_c_r = g(N_r), retiring the Israel well
H459.metric: pooled in-sample 0.2434 vs free mu_c 0.207 and base 0.198; Israel sign-up False
H459.note: the N state is 2-level and does not separate Israel from the gated decliners USA/France (all N=0.14), so an N-coupled ceiling that lifts Israel also wrongly lifts the decliners - it cannot isolate the well. Endogeneity adds nothing over the simpler recalibrated Israel scalar (H456).

H460.title: null: recuperation is a sign-only correction, accept DEF-8 as residual
H460.metric: H456 Israel-well recalibration clears a material magnitude win in-sample and out-of-sample with sign + Korea held
H460.note: the recuperation MECHANISM remains sign-only, but DEF-8 closes via the single-region error-model fix (H456), so the null that DEF-8 must be accepted as a residual is refuted.

H461.title: per-region grid / point-mass filter for g_rec_r
H461.metric: best held-out RMSE 0.2206 > shared pool 0.208 (no material OOS gain)
H461.note: a filter over a CONSTANT parameter with linear-Gaussian observation collapses to the static posterior; the recursion helps only if g_rec is genuinely time-varying, which it is not. INADMISSIBLE under H454.

H462.title: mechanistic POMP with partial pooling
H462.metric: matches the hierarchical fit (held-out 0.2279) > pool 0.208; no OOS gain
H462.note: the SSM machinery is interpretability-neutral overhead here; its only value is the honest likelihood that settles H453 (which declines the term), not a magnitude improvement. Occam prefers the simpler hierarchical fit; INADMISSIBLE under H454.

H463.title: filtering adjudicator - does the state-space formulation get a hold, or diffuse interpretability?
H463.metric: (a) pool 0.208 best; (c) filter 0.221, (d) POMP 0.228, (e) black-box 0.208 - none beat the pool materially
H463.note: the mechanistic filter and POMP do not beat the shared pool out-of-sample, and the black-box latent SSM only ties it (no wide-margin win) - so it does not justify trading away interpretability. Filtering does not move the numbers; the whole Act IV program is pruned, keeping the shared pool.

summary.disposition_text: DEF-8 CLOSES via H456: recalibrating the region-specific Israel pronatal-well scalar (0.06 -> 0.015) cuts Israel RMSE 0.367 -> 0.093, drops pooled in-sample RMSE 0.220 -> 0.180 (below baseline 0.198) and holds temporally OUT-OF-SAMPLE for the single Israel region (test RMSE 0.096; n=1 region, NOT cross-region generalization), with the sign gate (misses 0<=1 = True) and Korea monotone (True) both computed-preserved. The recuperation MECHANISM stays sign-only; the miss was a one-region error model.
